harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and set its login-session limits to 8192 open files (nofile) and 256 processes (nproc) via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf. Verified with a real login shell (su -l) both before and after a full node reboot, confirmed by a changed boot_id.
actions_performed: Checked appworker did not already exist on node1
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with soft/hard nofile 8192 and soft/hard nproc 256 for appworker
Verified limits via 'su -l appworker' + ulimit -n / ulimit -u (8192 / 256)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and account/config state as baseline
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 (non-blocking, ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified boot_id changed, confirming a genuine restart
Re-verified appworker account, limits.d config, and effective ulimits post-restart

evidence.summary: id/getent confirmed appworker did not exist beforehand, then useradd -m created it with uid/gid 1000.

evidence.requirement: Login session limits set to 8192 open files / 256 processes
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with nofile/nproc limits, then confirmed via 'su -l appworker; ulimit -n; ulimit -u' returning 8192 and 256.
Captured boot_id 5f3ce3b8-4860-447e-bcf1-d6643718694e and confirmed appworker account plus limits.d config present before restart.
systemctl reboot issued in background; acknowledgement (pid) returned before the node disconnected, confirmed by subsequent connection timeouts.

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart (node1)
evidence.summary: Node was unreachable (connection timed out) during reboot, then came back with boot_id dd716493-d139-444c-86a6-19f88175935f, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, and a fresh uptime -s timestamp.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required data/service state (node1)
evidence.summary: After restart, appworker account still exists, /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf is intact, and 'su -l appworker' still reports ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256.
